voiceover_script.text: Welcome to the documentary on empowering youth and ensuring responsible AI governance for a more inclusive future.
The world is facing a significant challenge in ensuring that AI systems are developed and used responsibly.
However, the benefits of AI can be fully realized only if we ensure that its development and application are guided by the principles of inclusivity, diversity, and equity.
To empower individuals with knowledge and choice while we cannot involve everybody in the design of fair systems.

One way this can be done is by training local researchers with paper-predictives to collect and fade value from sophisticated primary data, to understand the intersection of impacts of existing and AI use cases in the ecosystem.
In conclusion, ensuring responsible AI governance is crucial for creating a more inclusive future.
Thank you for watching this documentary on empowering youth and ensuring responsible AI governance for a more inclusive future.
